correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact one-deletion shadow bijection, collapses all character-coordinate factors by character order, derives the negative-binomial coefficient formula, and evaluates the order-character sum by Mobius inversion on the dual annihilator subgroup. It proves both directions of the spectrum-balance iff criterion using label translations and the support-one obstruction. The transfer graph statement follows from injective unit transfers and the exact shadow tiling. The standalone verifier independently compares all integer coefficients in 100 group-length instances and validates 15 cross-syndrome edge-count examples. These finite tests do not replace the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The motivating paper uses deletion-shadow size to derive sharp finite-block coding bounds, so the exact per-syndrome shadow-size distribution is a natural uncomputed invariant. The theorem gives all coefficients for every finite abelian full-label group, exact balance/nonbalance criterion, prime-alphabet two-profile law, and a group-structure-sensitive example. It determines exact decoder branching and transfer degrees rather than arbitrarily sliced computations. No downstream rate theorem is required or claimed.
